title: Nourishing Moroccan Mushrooms Mechoui
description: A fermented, crunchy, and cozy Moroccan dish featuring mushrooms that's friendly to those following a sugar-free diet. Perfect for a comforting meal after a long day.

ingredients.name: Scorched Fat (such as duck fat or coconut oil)
Coconut Sugar-free Sweetener (such as stevia or erythritol)
Spices (such as cumin, coriander, and cinnamon)

instructions: Combine the mushrooms and water in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the scorched fat, coconut sugar-free sweetener, olive oil, spices, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using).
Cover the bowl with a lid or plastic wrap and let it ferment at room temperature for 24-48 hours, stirring occasionally.
After fermentation, transfer the mixture to a saucepan and heat it over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Continue to heat the mixture for 10-15 minutes or until it reaches a temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Remove from heat and stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley and cilantro.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a side of rice or couscous, if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the mechoui over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
